- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.7) — reduce forecast peak values by 2–5%.
- Underestimate prices after sharp spikes (e.g., >80) — add 1–3% buffer to prevent undershoot.
- Lagged sentiment (last 3–5 days) strongly influences short-term correction — adjust forecast if sentiment drops below 0.5.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast > 82 and sentiment < 0.6, reduce by 3–6% to align with recent mean.
- Overshoot after high sentiment: if forecast > 85 and sentiment > 0.8, cap at 84–85 to avoid overcorrection.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts often overreact to recent volatility — dampen early peaks if sentiment is weak or mixed.
